work.title: Danger Laser Light
work.description: Mixed-media collage layering a top-down warplane silhouette over iridescent, paint-covered fragments. Collaged elements include a compact disc, a 'DANGER LASER LIGHT' warning label, a snowman figure, and partial fabric lettering, set against vivid orange, green, and black painted grounds.
work.composition: top-down warplane over layered collage fragments
keywords: danger laser light warning label collage
